entityDescription:
Imendo is an experienced IT partner with four business divisions and was recently named "Austria's Leading Company" by PwC, Die Presse and the Kreditschutzverband (1st place in Austria in the category of turnover up to EUR 10 million). This is the most important business award in Austria - we were not only recognized for our innovative solutions, but also for our many years of stable growth and excellent company figures. The 4 business areas are

-Enterprise Content Management & Intranet solutions based on Microsoft SharePoint, PowerPlatform and Teams (M365 Collaboration & Communication)
-Customized software development and software integration
-Data analytics & reporting solutions and data warehouse projects
-Cyber Security

More than 90 experienced software engineers, project managers, infrastructure experts and business consultants ensure that your projects are delivered on-budget, on-time and in-quality - but above all that you receive solutions that really support you and your company. Imendo competencies that form the basis of a successful project:

-Customizing close to the standard:
In particular in SharePoint Online-based projects we implement and customize close to Microsoft standards. In this way, we ensure that your SharePoint Online-based ECM solution can continue to be operated on the latest SharePoint configuration even after Microsoft updates.
-Functionality and design:
Imendo's software engineering is characterized by a flexible architecture tailored to the use case and optimal functionality paired with user-friendly interfaces.-Customer needs have priorityWhere individual solutions are necessary, these are adapted to the customer's processes and requirements. Processes are redesigned in consultation with the customer at those points where efficiency/throughput time or usability are required. Extensions can be made as required. Imendo ensures optimal adaptation to your business requirements with great foresight.
Multi-device / flexible use:
Cross-platform development is used to create applications that can be used on a wide variety of devices. Depending on specific requirements, the advantages of the different end devices are also used to create an appealing user experience (example: production / warehouse management vs. back office)
-Scaled, cloud-capable infrastructure:
The setup, configuration and customization of infrastructure components - especially for individual extensions - is implemented by Imendo according to the principles of the Microsoft Well-Architected Framework. Preference is given to the implementation of infrastructure components and the operation of applications based on the Azure Cloud Stack. The implementation of applications on the .NET platform enables the development of backend and web applications that can be integrated into almost all server infrastructures. Delivery and hosting can also take place in the form of Docker containers after customer coordination in order to enable hosting independently of the infrastructure or in a hybrid setup (on-premise in the data center, Azure Cloud or AWS).

entityDescription: The University of Évora is composed of the Schools of Arts, Sciences and Technology, Social Sciences, Health and Human Development and Nursing. Research and Development (R&D) covers various scientific areas through a network of 8 Research Chairs, 4 Collaborative Laboratories, 5 Associated Laboratories, 14 Research Infrastructures and in the centre of the Main R&D the University of Évora has 19 Research Units, all subject to international evaluation, under the coordination of the Institute for Research and Advanced Training (IIFA). The most relevant research centre for the present project is the Comprehensive Health Research Center (CHRC). The CHRC is a multidisciplinary, multi-institutional and integrated research centre, aimed at supporting, developing and promoting clinical, public health and health services research. Other pillars and core activities of the CHRC are health education and training, innovation, digital health and entrepreneurship. It is organised in 4 thematic lines: Health promotion, public health and lifestyles; Diseases with high impact and high mortality rate; Health policies and healthcare development; Innovation in health. The University has about 270 R&D projects running, developed through national and international partnerships, funding such as Erasmus+, Life, H2020, Horizon Europe, PT2020, Alentejo 2020 programme and also through private sponsorship.

entityDescription:
Politechnika Innowacje sp. z o.o., a special-purpose company of Poznań University of Technology, was established by a notarial deed dated January 15, 2016, based on the provisions of the Law on Higher Education.

Its purpose is indirect commercialization (taking up shares in spin-off companies), which is a formal supplement to the competences of the Poznań University of Technology Technology Technology Transfer Center, which is responsible for direct commercialization (mainly the sale and licensing of rights to the results of scientific activities). 100% of the company's shares are held by Poznan University of Technology.

The business model of Politechnika Innowacje assumes cooperation with the University's socio-economic environment in offering research services and carrying out commissioned work aimed at solving specific problems, primarily technological and organizational.

The bodies of the company are the Assembly of Shareholders and the Board of Directors - the position of President of the company since September 2020 is held by Prof. Michal Wieczorowski, PhD, Vice-Rector for Development and Cooperation with the Economy of PP.

SC PP is a member of the Agreement of Special Purpose Companies.

entityDescription:
WWT was established in 1946 by the pioneering conservationist Sir Peter Scott, the son of Antarctic explorer Captain Scott. Peter Scott pioneered the idea that taking action to save wetlands and their wildlife involves both inspiring people to care about wetlands and undertaking direct conservation. He set up WWT at Slimbridge, Gloucestershire, as a centre for science and conservation. Uniquely at the time, he opened it to the public so that everyone could enjoy getting close to nature.
WWT is now one of the largest and most respected wetland conservation organisations in the world. We welcome over a million visitors every year to our ten wetland centres and reserves across the UK and we have global reach for our projects to protect wetlands for the people and wildlife that rely on them. In recognition of our expertise in promoting sustainable development through wetland conservation, WWT has been endorsed as one of only six International Organisation Partners by the 170 countries that are signatories to the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands.
We are pioneers in saving threatened wetland wildlife, world experts in wetland management and creation, and a centre for excellence in conservation science.

entityDescription:
VES Robotics Applications, is a young engineering company that develops aerial robotics services and projects to improve the functionality, reliability and safety of unmanned aerial systems for industrial applications. The team consists of UAV engineers and pilots, specialized in the application of UAS to inspection and maintenance, including industrial plants and civil infrastructures, achieving significant cost savings, increasing safety and improving efficiency, including reductions in inspection time.Our motivation comes from wanting to provide a solution to a need required by the industrial sector, which is the optimization of inspections and maintenance in hazardous or difficult to access areas. We have observed that the costs of such inspections are high, the times are long and the possibility of human accidents is high. With our technology we want to reduce these factors by making these operations more efficient and above all safe.Our value proposition is the use of advanced technology and innovation to provide a different and specific service. The target market is focused on refineries, petrochemical, energy sector among others.

The initial strategy presented by our company is to take three aspects hand in hand:- Innovation: To participate in all possible European and national projects in order to advance and improve our technologies by providing the real and service part.- Service: Helping companies in the industrial sector to optimize their inspections and maintenance.- Broaden horizons: To take our technology to other areas that also require this solution

entityDescription:
Bianor Holding Plc provides niche tech specialization, delivering advanced mission-critical applications for real-time data streaming, AI, machine learning, cloud services, DevOps and digital transformation. The company helps visionary enterprises from the Telecom, Media, IT, Aerospace and Defense industries succeed and drive positive change through technology. Bianor builds on 25 years of flawless reputation in technology innovation, domain expertise, and reliable engineering for clients like Northrop Grumman, AT&T, IBM, Bosch, NOKIA, Indra, Leonardo, The Library of Congress, etc.

Aerospace & Defense:
Bianor is a certified security affairs operator. It has a successful history of several large-scale mission-critical ventures for NATO and the EU. Currently, the company is a preferred software services vendor for large technology consortiums financed by the European Defence Fund. Bianor partners with the world's defense industry leaders like Northrop Grumman, Indra, Leonardo, Thales, and Rheinmetall.

Telecom & Media: In the course of the last 15 years, Bianor has been developing profound expertise in the fields of video streaming and real-time data processing and transferring. The solutions implemented by the company serve millions of people, ensuring services provided by telco and media forerunners like AT&T, DirectTV, A1, Nova Broadcasting Group, and others. The company has been at the core of the foundation of FITE, a premier digital platform for global sports and entertainment, now part of TrillerVerz Corp.

High-Tech & Software:
Bianor stays on the edge of contemporary technologies by expanding its artificial intelligence and machine learning expertise. The company applies its AI know-how in various projects in the IT sector and the financial data analysis domain. AI-based solutions developed by Bianor bring user-flow optimization and higher customer satisfaction, resulting in increased revenues for major US-based e-commerce retailers.

Company description: The National Institute for Agrarian and Veterinarian Research I. P. (INIAV) is the State Laboratory of the Ministry of Agriculture and Food, that develops research activities in the agricultural and veterinary fields. It has the task of carrying out scientific and policy research to support public policies, while defending the national interests and the deepening of Europe’s common policies. Additionally, INIAV provides laboratory services and scientific and technical support to both farmers and industry. Its National Reference Laboratories perform official analysis in the fields of Animal Health, Plant Health, Food and Feed Safety. Moreover, the preservation and management of the plant and animal germplasm’s databases as well as of the national collections of reference are also included in INIAV’s responsibilities. 
INIAV’s core competences may be summarized as follows: 
- To develop the scientific and technological basis that supports the definition of the public sector policies;
- To promote the activities of research, experimentation and demonstration, according to the public policies’ guidelines designed for each sector, in order to ensure the technical and scientific support that leads to the development, innovation and improved competitiveness in areas such as the forestry, crop’s protection, food production, animal health and food safety, as well as in the area of food technology and biotechnology with application in those areas;
- To ensure its National Reference Laboratory role, broadening the spectrum of laboratory testing particularly in the areas of food safety, animal health and plant protection and health; 
- To cooperate with related scientific and technological institutions, and participate in national and international science and technology activities.
INIAV’s performance in areas such as Food Safety, Plant Health, Animal Health and Genetic Resources (preservation and conservation) can bring a both unique and fundamental contribution to the country’s development. (www.iniav.pt)

Smarter Diagnostics revolutionizes the approach athletes, both professionals and amateurs, take towards their health and fitness. Our mission, "Empower your fitness and avoid injuries with AI and MRI diagnostics," delivers cutting-edge solutions using artificial intelligence and MRI to assess soft tissue health, particularly in the lower limb.
Our innovative diagnostics enable "Elevating your sports performance" by identifying potential risks early and providing personalized preventive recommendations to avoid injuries and enhance athletic development. We believe in "Limitless activity, safer sports," emphasizing preventive care and education for enduring passion in sports without the fear of injuries.
With technology developed by experts, Smarter Diagnostics offers more than just diagnostics; we provide comprehensive support at every step of your sports journey, from prevention and training optimization to recovery and rehabilitation. Our goal is to enable everyone to be their best self in sports, enjoying long-term health and peak performance.

entityDescription:
About SparxSystems Central Europe
Sparx Systems Pty Ltd (Australia) was founded in 1996 and is the manufacturer of Enterprise Architect,
a globally successful UML modeling platform. Enterprise Architect is used to design and build soft-
ware systems, to model business processes and to model any process or system. Enterprise Architect
in its current version is valued by over one million users for its performance at an unbeatable price.
Enterprise Architect is an easy-to-understand, team-oriented modeling environment that supports
companies in the analysis, design and creation of precisely traceable and documented systems. With
the help of this tool, companies are enabled to centrally collect and display the often very distributed
knowledge of teams and departments.
In order to offer the best service around Enterprise Architect to the numerous customers in their lan-
guage and time zone, SparxSystems Software Central Europe was created in 2004, which supports
the entire German-speaking region in the acquisition of licenses as well as through training and con-
sulting.
